title: Port of Registration
text: 5.05 Port of Registration EPCG Authorisation shall be issued with a single port of registration as per paragraph 4.35 of HBP, for imports. However, exports can be made from any port specified in paragraph 4.35 of HBP.
intent: Support Port of Registration processing and compliance validation.
